Clearer installs, smarter auto-backup, and smoother sheets.

## What's new

- **See what you're installing.** When an app is already on your phone, the install sheet shows the installed version and the new one side by side, highlights exactly what changed, and says whether it's a major, minor or patch update, or an older version.
- **A calmer install sheet.** Smaller, iOS-style type, short messages, and a quick overview of new apps: version, size and the Android version they need.
- **Auto-backup remembers each app's format.** A split app is backed up as an APK or an APKS bundle, whichever you pick under Save As in its details. The backup line shows which.
- **See every app you back up.** Settings → Auto-Backup lists them, with each app's format and when it was last saved. Turn one off or on right there, or tap it to open the app. Apps with auto-backup on also show a small green arrow in the app list.
- **APKS by default.** Split apps are now saved as APKS bundles unless you choose otherwise. They keep the original signature, so a saved copy can later update the Play Store version. You can switch back to Single APK in Settings.
- **Choose the format when extracting several apps.** If the selection includes split apps, Extract asks whether to save them as single APKs or APKS bundles, just like Share.

## Fixes

- Sheets no longer bounce when dragged up, and swiping down to scroll back up no longer pulls the whole sheet down.
- A sheet now needs a deliberate pull or flick to close, instead of closing at the slightest drag.
- Installing an app that's still installed in Secure Folder, Dual Messenger or another user now explains what's blocking it, instead of a vague "conflict" error.
- History's empty screen is centred.

## Download

Get **`apk-extractor-v1.6.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. It updates v1.5.0 in place, keeping your settings and history. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.

The Split Apps setting moves to APKS once with this update. If you prefer one merged APK, change it back in Settings → Split Apps.
